functional_geometry.solid: one watertight, winding-consistent, edge-connected positive-volume solid

hard_constraints: Produce the required STL as one watertight, winding-consistent, edge-connected positive-volume solid rather than only reporting metrics.
Stay inside the stated coordinate envelope and above the minimum useful spans.
Stay within the stated material-volume range.
Retain the quantified continuous z=0 base contact and separated tall-finger geometry at the z=24 mm probe.
Do not read ground_truth, edit eval.py, or fabricate score/metric files.
invalid_conditions: Missing, unparsable, empty, or implausibly small STL geometry.
Bounding-box, coordinate-envelope, volume, solid-validity, base-contact, finger-count, thickness, gap, or openness violation.
Native project files used as the only deliverable.
metric: 0.72 * surface_area/volume plus 0.28 * side-clearance-span/volume; taller separated cable fingers with less material score higher
objective: Maximize cable clearance and exposed side surface per material volume for a cable-comb organizer.
